summary: Intel Corp filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for an offering of multiple series of senior notes. The filing does not disclose specific amounts, interest rates, or maturities as the terms are subject to completion. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing debt, with no sinking fund and no exchange listing. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. There is no change of control, merger, tender, restructuring, or other special event.
